_how: One entry per Modal workspace in Lino's GPU pool. The token itself is a secret (MODAL_TOKEN_ID/SECRET, MODAL_EXTRA_TOKENS); token_sha256 is the first 12 hex characters of the sha256 of its token id. url is where Lino answers in that workspace. plan_usd: monthly free credits; they reset on the first of the month.
